skm=spatialKMeans(test, r=1, k=2)

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: topfeatures spatial kmeans
parts:
- topFeatures() will be added for SpatialKMeans2 based on post-hoc correlation

- Adding topFeatures() for PLS and OPLS is less trivial due to many possible ways of interpreting the coef/weights/loadings -- however these can be extracted using resultData() and ranked manually if needed.

-Kylie
